 by('mReplay').onclick=()=>{if(!spoken(voice))by('mech-feedback').textContent='这段英语录音尚未安装。请先看图片、英文和中文提示。 Audio not installed yet.'};
 by('mGuide').onclick=()=>spoken(ZIG_VOICE_GUIDES[mode]||DESCRIPTIONS[mode][2]);
 by('mHelp').onclick=()=>{state.accuracy.hints++;save();let x=by('mHint');x.classList.remove('hidden');x.textContent=cn};

 mechDone=true;state.accuracy.correct++;state.first.total++;if(!missFirst)state.first.right++;state.completedRounds[mode]=(state.completedRounds[mode]||0)+1;blip(true);if(turn===7)spoken('Great work! You found a crystal!');save();
 let f=by('mech-feedback');if(f){f.className='feedback good';f.innerHTML=`<strong>✨ Mission success!</strong> ${esc(explanation)} <div style="margin-top:12px"><button class="action" id="mNext">${turn===7?'🏆 Finish mission':'Continue → 下一题'}</button></div>`;by('mNext').onclick=()=>{stopMech();nextRound()}};

  svg.setAttribute('x2',x);svg.setAttribute('y2','44');svg.setAttribute('opacity','1');btn.classList.add('fired');mechTimer=setTimeout(()=>svg.setAttribute('opacity','0'),360);

 });

function droneGame(i){let [topic,word]=DRONE_WORDS[i],pool=BANK[topic];let item=pickEntry(word,topic);let ix=pool.findIndex(v=>v.en===word);
 let candidates=[item,pool[(ix+3)%pool.length],pool[(ix+7)%pool.length],pool[(ix+12)%pool.length]];candidates=shuffled(candidates,i+3);let points=[[18,24],[76,19],[21,72],[77,70]];let pos={x:49,y:50},target=null;
 const content=`<div class="mech-intro"><div class="mech-narration"><span>🎯 Rescue the picture:</span><strong>${esc(word)}</strong><small>🔊 听单词，移动飞船靠近图片，再扫描。点击图片也可以自动飞过去。</small></div><div class="mech-card tinycard" id="droneClue"><strong style="font-size:46px">🛰️</strong><small>Find it!</small></div></div><div class="drone-map" id="droneMap">${candidates.map((v,k)=>`<button class="wild-target" style="left:${points[k][0]}%;top:${points[k][1]}%" data-pick="${esc(v.en)}" data-x="${points[k][0]}" data-y="${points[k][1]}"><img src="${img(v.id)}" alt="animal or object"><span class="wild-beacon">✦</span></button>`).join('')}<div class="hoverdrone" id="hoverDrone" style="left:49%;top:50%">${sprite('drone')}</div></div><div class="controlbar"><button class="dpad" data-step="left">◀</button><button class="dpad" data-step="up">▲</button><button class="dpad" data-step="down">▼</button><button class="dpad" data-step="right">▶</button><button class="action secondary" id="scanDrone">◉ Scan / 扫描</button></div>`;
 mechShell('Wildlife Rescue · 救援巡航','移动小飞船：方向键／WASD／屏幕方向键。靠近目标并扫描；也可以直接点击目标让飞船自动前往。',content,word);
 let dr=by('hoverDrone'),bt=by('scanDrone'),markers=[...by('droneMap').querySelectorAll('[data-pick]')];
 function move(){dr.style.left=pos.x+'%';dr.style.top=pos.y+'%'}
 function scan(){let near=markers.map(e=>({e,d:Math.hypot(pos.x-(+e.dataset.x),pos.y-(+e.dataset.y))})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d)[0];if(!near||near.d>21){by('mech-feedback').textContent='Fly closer! 再靠近一点。';return}near.e.classList.add('scanned');completeMech(near.e.dataset.pick===word,word,()=>{near.e.classList.add('rescued');dr.classList.add('celebrate-drone')})}
 markers.forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{if(mechDone)return;pos.x=+e.dataset.x;pos.y=+e.dataset.y;target=e;move();mechTimer=setTimeout(scan,650)});
 const defaultDroneHelp=by('mHelp').onclick;by('mHelp').onclick=()=>{defaultDroneHelp();by('droneClue').innerHTML=`<img src="${getImg(word,topic)}" alt="target"><small>${esc(item.zh)}</small>`};
 by('play-area').querySelectorAll('[data-step]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const d=e.dataset.step;pos.x=Math.max(7,Math.min(93,pos.x+(d==='left'?-11:d==='right'?11:0)));pos.y=Math.max(8,Math.min(92,pos.y+(d==='up'?-11:d==='down'?11:0)));move()});
 bt.onclick=scan;
 // arrow keys work only on this active mission and are unbound on exit

}

 const content=`<div class="mech-narration">🚚 Sort the cargo! 把太空箱放入正确的分类舱。</div><div class="conveyor"><div class="conveyor-belt"></div><button class="cargo-crate" draggable="true" id="cargoCrate"><img src="${img(item.id)}" alt="${esc(word)}"><b>${esc(word)}</b><small>${esc(item.zh)}</small></button></div><div class="cargo-bins">${choices.map(c=>`<button class="cargo-bin" data-bin="${c}"><span>⬇</span><b>${LABELS[c][2]} ${LABELS[c][0]}</b><small>${LABELS[c][1]}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;

function reactorGame(i){let chunks=PHRASE_WORDS[i],required=chunks.slice(0,chunks.length===3&&chunks[2]=== '困倦的'?2:chunks.length); // handle adjective annotations

 const content=`<div class="mech-intro"><div class="mech-card"><img src="${pic}" alt="word picture"><small>${hint}</small></div><div class="mech-narration"><strong>Build an invention!</strong><span>把词块按正确顺序装入机器。 Tap tiles or drag them onto the machine.</span></div></div><div class="reactor-scene"><div class="reactor-machine">${sprite('drone')}<div id="reactorSlots" class="reactor-slots"><span>⚙️ Word machine / 词块机器</span></div><div id="reactorAnim" class="reactor-sparks">✨</div></div></div><div id="reactorBank" class="mech-tilebar">${tiles.map(x=>`<button class="mech-tile" draggable="true" data-tid="${x.id}">${esc(x.word)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="actions"><button class="action" id="reactorCheck">⚙️ Build / 启动</button><button class="action ghost" id="reactorReset">↶ Start over</button></div>`;
 mechShell('Alien Invention Factory · 外星发明工厂','先看图片与中文提示，再把英文词块按正确顺序放入机器。短语不是整句。',content,required.join(' '));
 let selected=[];
 function draw(){by('reactorSlots').innerHTML=selected.length?selected.map((id,k)=>`<button class="mech-tile occupied" data-index="${k}">${esc(required[id])} ×</button>`).join(''):'<span>Drop words here · 把词块放在这里</span>';by('reactorSlots').querySelectorAll('[data-index]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{selected.splice(+el.dataset.index,1);draw()});by('reactorBank').querySelectorAll('[data-tid]').forEach(el=>el.disabled=selected.includes(+el.dataset.tid))}
 by('reactorBank').querySelectorAll('[data-tid]').forEach(el=>{el.onclick=()=>{if(!selected.includes(+el.dataset.tid)){selected.push(+el.dataset.tid);draw()}};el.addEventListener('dragstart',e=>e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',el.dataset.tid))});
 by('reactorSlots').addEventListener('dragover',e=>e.preventDefault());by('reactorSlots').addEventListener('drop',e=>{e.preventDefault();let id=+e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');if(!selected.includes(id)){selected.push(id);draw()}});
 by('reactorReset').onclick=()=>{selected=[];draw()};by('reactorCheck').onclick=()=>completeMech(selected.join(',')===required.map((_,k)=>k).join(','),required.join(' '),()=>by('reactorAnim').classList.add('activated'));

function railGame(i){let chunks=RAIL_SENTENCES[i],tiles=shuffled(chunks.map((word,id)=>({word,id})),i+9),chosenIds=[];
 const content=`<div class="mech-intro"><div class="mech-narration"><strong>Connect the sentence train!</strong><span>按正确顺序连接车厢。Tap or drag them into place.</span><small>每个句子有主语和动词。不要只把单词乱放在一起。</small></div>${sprite('train','rail-preview')}</div><div class="rail-world"><div class="rail-track"><div class="rail-engine">🚄</div><div class="rail-cars" id="railCars"><span class="muted">Train cars here · 这里排列句子</span></div></div><div class="train-road">══════════════════════════════════════</div></div><div id="railBank" class="mech-tilebar">${tiles.map(x=>`<button class="mech-tile carriage" data-tid="${x.id}" draggable="true">${esc(x.word)}<span class="wheelrow">⚙ ⚙</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="actions"><button class="action" id="launchTrain">🚀 Launch the train</button><button class="action ghost" id="resetTrain">↶ Reset</button></div>`;

 by('railBank').querySelectorAll('[data-tid]').forEach(el=>{el.onclick=()=>{if(!chosenIds.includes(+el.dataset.tid)){chosenIds.push(+el.dataset.tid);draw()}};el.addEventListener('dragstart',e=>e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',el.dataset.tid))});

 by('resetTrain').onclick=()=>{chosenIds=[];draw()};by('launchTrain').onclick=()=>completeMech(chosenIds.join(',')===chunks.map((_,k)=>k).join(','),chunks.join(' '),()=>{by('railCars').classList.add('departing');spoken(chunks.join(' '))});
}
function readerGame(i){let [question,correct,answers]=READER_TASKS[i],story=PIP_READER.map((x,k)=>`<button class="reader-line" data-line="${k}"><b>${k+1}.</b> ${esc(x)} <small>🔎</small></button>`).join('');
 const content=`<div class="transmission"><div class="reader-head">📡 Pip's island afternoon — 收到的阅读信息<button id="toggleReaderCn" class="hint">中文解释</button></div><div id="readerLines">${story}</div><div id="readerCn" class="reader-cn hidden">${READER_CN.map((x,k)=>`<div>${k+1}. ${x}</div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="reader-task"><strong>❓ ${esc(question)}</strong><div class="mech-choice-grid">${shuffled(answers,i+2).map(x=>`<button class="mech-choice" data-reader="${esc(x)}">${esc(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
 mechShell('Transmission Reader · 宇宙讯息阅读','先读六句话。找到问题中的信息，再选择答案。可点击某一句查看词义提示，或打开中文解释。',content,question);
 by('toggleReaderCn').onclick=()=>by('readerCn').classList.toggle('hidden');by('readerLines').querySelectorAll('[data-line]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{by('readerCn').classList.remove('hidden');by('readerCn').children[+el.dataset.line]?.classList.add('highlight');spoken(PIP_READER[+el.dataset.line])});
 by('play-area').querySelectorAll('[data-reader]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>completeMech(el.dataset.reader===correct,correct,()=>el.classList.add('answer-correct')));
}
function bridgeGame(i){let [sentence,correct,choices,target]=BRIDGE_REASONS[i],image=getImg(target),text=sentence.replace('____','_______');
 const content=`<div class="mech-intro"><div class="mech-card"><img src="${image}" alt="${esc(target)}"><small>${esc(target)}</small></div><div class="mech-narration"><b>${esc(text)}</b><span>在桥上安装正确的原因。Which reason makes sense?</span></div></div><div class="bridge-world"><div class="bridge-base">${sprite('bridge')}<div id="bridgeSpan" class="bridge-span"></div><div class="bridge-ship">${sprite('drone')}</div></div></div><div class="reason-options">${shuffled(choices,i+3).map(x=>`<button class="reason-panel" data-reason="${esc(x)}">${esc(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
 mechShell('Broken Space Bridge · 复合句太空桥','读清句子中 because（因为）的前半部分，选择合乎逻辑的原因，让太空桥连起来。',content,sentence);
 by('play-area').querySelectorAll('[data-reason]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>completeMech(el.dataset.reason===correct,sentence.replace('____',correct),()=>{by('bridgeSpan').classList.add('connected');by('play-area').querySelector('.bridge-ship').classList.add('crossing');el.classList.add('answer-correct')}));
}
function interviewGame(i){let [topic,category,...words]=INTERVIEW_DATA[i],chosenWord=null,clause=[];let answers=words.map(w=>pickEntry(w,topic)).filter(Boolean);
 const content=`<div class="mech-intro"><div class="mech-narration"><strong>📻 Alien Radio Interview</strong><span>What’s your favorite ${esc(category)}?</span><small>先挑一个你喜欢的，再把英文句子连好。你可以自己选择，没有错误的喜好。</small></div></div><div class="interview-choices">${answers.map(v=>`<button class="interview-pick" data-fav="${esc(v.en)}"><img src="${img(v.id)}" alt="${esc(v.en)}"><b>${esc(v.en)}</b></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="interview-builder"><div id="radioLine">⬜⬜⬜ Choose your favorite above</div><div id="radioChunks" class="mech-tilebar"></div><button id="radioSend" class="action">📡 Send / 发送</button><button id="radioClear" class="action ghost">↶ Clear</button></div>`;
 mechShell('Alien Radio Interview · 星际采访','选择你自己的真实答案。然后使用课堂学过的 My favorite ... is ... 句型组成句子。最后自己大声读一句，按发送。',content,`What's your favorite ${category}?`);
 by('play-area').querySelectorAll('[data-fav]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{chosenWord=el.dataset.fav;clause=[];by('play-area').querySelectorAll('[data-fav]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('selected',b===el));draw()});
 function chunks(){let value=(category==='animal'?'a ':category==='place'?'the ':'')+chosenWord;return ['My favorite',category,'is',value+'.']}
 function draw(){by('radioLine').textContent=clause.length?clause.map(i=>chunks()[i]).join(' '):'Tap the chunks below / 点击词块组合句子';let arr=shuffled(chunks().map((s,i)=>({s,i})),i+4);by('radioChunks').innerHTML=arr.map(x=>`<button class="mech-tile" data-idx="${x.i}" ${clause.includes(x.i)?'disabled':''}>${esc(x.s)}</button>`).join('');by('radioChunks').querySelectorAll('[data-idx]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{if(!clause.includes(+el.dataset.idx)){clause.push(+el.dataset.idx);draw()}})}
 by('radioClear').onclick=()=>{clause=[];if(chosenWord)draw()};by('radioSend').onclick=()=>{if(!chosenWord){by('mech-feedback').textContent='Pick your favorite first! 先选你最喜欢的。';return}completeMech(clause.join(',')==='0,1,2,3',chunks().join(' '),()=>{state.said++;save();by('radioLine').classList.add('broadcasting');spoken(chunks().join(' '))})};
}
// Replace the old finale with a playable zero-punishment spaceship arcade and integrated language checks.
const FINALE_STOPS=[{"prompt":"Pick the word beginning with b.","zh":"选出以 b 开头的词。","options":["badminton","dolphin","turtle"],"correct":"badminton"},{"prompt":"Find a food.","zh":"选择一种食物。","options":["dumplings","skating","library"],"correct":"dumplings"},{"prompt":"Build the phrase in order.","zh":"选择正确的短语。","options":["sleepy bear","bear sleepy","is bear"],"correct":"sleepy bear"},{"prompt":"Which sentence is complete?","zh":"选择完整的句子。","options":["My favorite sport is badminton.","My favorite sport badminton.","Badminton favorite my."],"correct":"My favorite sport is badminton."},{"prompt":"Choose a sensible reason.","zh":"选择合适的原因。","options":["I like the library because I can read books.","I like the library because it is pizza.","I like the library because soccer."],"correct":"I like the library because I can read books."}];
let shipState=null;
finale=function(){page='finale';mode='finalship';theme(5,'THE FINAL FLIGHT','🚀 <em>Zig’s Starship Rescue</em>','Pilot Zig home and complete five integrated English checks.');zsay('Fly the ship, collect stars, and answer the English questions.','Fly the ship, collect stars, and answer the English questions.');
 by('main').innerHTML=`<section class="glass mech-game immersive-scene"><div class="sectiontitle"><h2>🚀 The Great Escape / 星际大冒险</h2><small>收集能量球 · collect energy stars</small></div><div class="flight-area" id="flightArea"><div class="star-layer" id="starLayer"></div><div id="pilotShip" class="pilot-ship">${sprite('rocket')}</div><div class="asteroid a1">☄️</div><div class="asteroid a2">🪨</div></div><div class="flight-hud"><span>Collected / 收集: <b id="flightStars">0</b> / 5</span><span>Checkpoints / 英语挑战: <b id="flightChecks">0</b> / 5</span></div><div class="controlbar"><button class="dpad" data-flight="left">◀</button><button class="dpad" data-flight="up">▲</button><button class="dpad" data-flight="down">▼</button><button class="dpad" data-flight="right">▶</button><button class="action secondary" id="flightStart">▶ Launch</button></div><div id="flightQuestion"></div><p class="muted">没有生命值惩罚，没有倒计时。碰到小行星只会轻轻弹开。 No lives lost.</p></section>`;
 shipState={x:49,y:70,stars:0,check:0,started:false,pause:false};drawFlight();
 by('main').querySelectorAll('[data-flight]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>moveFlight(el.dataset.flight));by('flightStart').onclick=()=>{shipState.started=true;by('flightStart').disabled=true;layoutStars()};
};
function drawFlight(){if(!shipState)return;let o=by('pilotShip');if(o){o.style.left=shipState.x+'%';o.style.top=shipState.y+'%'};if(by('flightStars'))by('flightStars').textContent=shipState.stars;if(by('flightChecks'))by('flightChecks').textContent=shipState.check}
function layoutStars(){let layer=by('starLayer');if(!layer)return;let loc=[[18,24],[82,48],[31,66],[65,19],[45,32]];layer.innerHTML=loc.map(([x,y],i)=>`<button class="flight-star" data-star="${i}" style="left:${x}%;top:${y}%">⭐</button>`).join('');layer.querySelectorAll('[data-star]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{if(!shipState||shipState.pause)return;shipState.x=+el.style.left.slice(0,-1);shipState.y=+el.style.top.slice(0,-1);drawFlight();grabFlightStar(el)})}
function moveFlight(dir){if(!shipState?.started||shipState.pause)return;shipState.x=Math.max(4,Math.min(94,shipState.x+(dir==='left'?-13:dir==='right'?13:0)));shipState.y=Math.max(7,Math.min(90,shipState.y+(dir==='up'?-13:dir==='down'?13:0)));drawFlight();let stars=[...by('starLayer').querySelectorAll('[data-star]')];for(let el of stars){let x=+el.style.left.slice(0,-1),y=+el.style.top.slice(0,-1);if(Math.hypot(shipState.x-x,shipState.y-y)<12){grabFlightStar(el);break}}}
function grabFlightStar(el){if(!shipState||shipState.pause)return;shipState.pause=true;el.classList.add('collected');el.disabled=true;shipState.stars++;drawFlight();let check=shipState.check,q=FINALE_STOPS[check],elQ=by('flightQuestion');
 elQ.innerHTML=`<div class="final-check"><h3>⭐ Checkpoint ${check+1} of 5</h3><p>${esc(q.prompt)} <span lang="zh">${q.zh}</span> <button class="hint" id="flightSpeak">🔊 Hear question</button></p><div class="mech-choice-grid">${shuffled(q.options,check+3).map(a=>`<button class="mech-choice" data-final="${esc(a)}">${esc(a)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div id="checkFeedback" class="feedback"></div></div>`;
 by('flightSpeak').onclick=()=>spoken(q.prompt);spoken(q.prompt);elQ.querySelectorAll('[data-final]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(b.dataset.final!==q.correct){by('checkFeedback').textContent='Try again. 再试一次！';blip(false);spoken('Try another one.');return}blip(true);if(turn===7)spoken('Great work! You found a crystal!');spoken(q.correct);shipState.check++;drawFlight();elQ.innerHTML='<div class="feedback good">⭐ Checkpoint repaired! 太棒了！</div>';if(shipState.check===5){save();setTimeout(()=>shipVictory(),480)}else{shipState.pause=false;let left=by('starLayer').querySelectorAll('[data-star]:not([disabled])');if(!left.length)layoutStars()}})
}
function shipVictory(){spoken('You fixed the star map! Well done, Allen!');state.finale=true;save();page='victory';theme(5,'MISSION ACCOMPLISHED','✨ <em>Welcome home, Zig!</em>','Five crystals power the repaired star map.');by('main').innerHTML=`<div class="celebrate"><div class="big">🚀🌟💎</div><h2>YOU SAVED THE GALAXY!</h2><p>Zig’s ship is home. Your sounds, words, phrases and sentences brought it back!</p><p lang="zh">恭喜！你已经完成音素、词汇、短语、完整句子和原因句的全部关卡。</p><div class="stars">⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐</div><div class="actions" style="justify-content:center"><button class="action" id="makeCert">🏅 Print your certificate</button><button class="action secondary" id="vAtlas">📖 Explore 144 Words</button><button class="action ghost" id="vHome">🌌 Galaxy Map</button></div></div>`;by('makeCert').onclick=()=>{let w=window.open('','_blank');if(!w){flash('Enable popups to print the certificate.');return}w.document.write('<html><head><title>Allen Space Quest Certificate</title></head><body style="font-family:system-ui;text-align:center;padding:10vh;background:#f4f6ff;color:#233478"><h1>⭐ SPACE QUEST CERTIFICATE ⭐</h1><h2>Allen</h2><p>Helped Zig repair the star map using English!</p><h1>🚀 🌠 💎 🌠 🚀</h1><p>Sounds • Words • Phrases • Sentences • Reasons</p><button onclick="window.print()">Print</button></body></html>');w.document.close()};by('vAtlas').onclick=()=>atlas();by('vHome').onclick=()=>home()}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(page==='finale'&&shipState?.started){let d={'ArrowLeft':'left','a':'left','ArrowRight':'right','d':'right','ArrowUp':'up','w':'up','ArrowDown':'down','s':'down'}[e.key];if(d){e.preventDefault();moveFlight(d)}}});
// Existing lesson-wide teacher dashboard gets a correct first-attempt metric.
teacher=function(){oldTeacher();const s=state.first||{right:0,total:0},row=by('reportHint');if(row)row.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<p>New physical games: ${Object.values(state.completedRounds||{}).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)} successful rounds. First-attempt score in those games: ${s.total?Math.round(s.right*100/s.total):'—'}% (${s.right}/${s.total}); retries are logged separately. Final flight: ${state.finale?'completed':'pending'}.</p>`);};
const _currentHome=home;
home=function(){stopMech();_currentHome();
  if(!by('zigWelcomeBtn')){
    by('main').insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<button id="zigWelcomeBtn" class="action" style="display:block;margin:0 auto 22px;min-height:58px" aria-label="Hear Zig introduce the adventure">🔊 Hear Zig’s welcome · 听 Zig 介绍</button>');
    by('zigWelcomeBtn').onclick=()=>spoken('Hello, Allen! I am Zig, your alien friend! Help me repair the Lost Star Map.');
  }
};
// Auto-retrieve already-approved Jesse recordings once online; cache actual mp3 bytes in IndexedDB for offline replay.
// This uses the public user-owned GitHub game repository. It never calls ElevenLabs at runtime.
const JESSE_BASE='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loganrossbryant-ai/EAL-Game/codex/alan-favorites-cafe/eal-adventure/assets/voice/';
const JESSE_FILES=[...new Set(Object.values(VOICE_MAP))];
const voiceCacheOpen=()=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!window.indexedDB)return reject('no IndexedDB');const r=indexedDB.open('zig-approved-jesse-mp3-v2',1);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>r.result.createObjectStore('clips');r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)});
function voiceGet(db,key){return new Promise(resolve=>{let tr=db.transaction('clips','readonly');let r=tr.objectStore('clips').get(key);r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>resolve(null)})}
function voicePut(db,key,value){return new Promise(resolve=>{let tr=db.transaction('clips','readwrite');tr.objectStore('clips').put(value,key);tr.oncomplete=()=>resolve(true);tr.onerror=()=>resolve(false)})}
function voiceStatus(text){let el=document.querySelector('#voiceState');if(el)el.textContent='240 new Jesse clips embedded offline · '+text}
async function loadApprovedJesse(){let db;try{db=await voiceCacheOpen()}catch{return}let available=0;for(const key of JESSE_FILES){const blob=await voiceGet(db,key);if(blob){VOICE_BASE64[key]=URL.createObjectURL(blob);available++}}voiceStatus(`${available}/${JESSE_FILES.length} Jesse voice clips ready`);
 return; // mobile-offline: only existing locally cached legacy clips; no online fetching
 const missing=JESSE_FILES.filter(k=>!VOICE_BASE64[k]);let index=0,done=0;
 // Stop promptly when the public host is blocked (common on restricted networks).
 try {let ctrl=new AbortController();let t=setTimeout(()=>ctrl.abort(),3000);let probe=await fetch(JESSE_BASE+missing[0],{signal:ctrl.signal,cache:'force-cache'});clearTimeout(t);if(!probe.ok)throw new Error('source blocked');let blob=await probe.blob();if(blob.size<3000)throw new Error('empty clip');await voicePut(db,missing[0],blob);VOICE_BASE64[missing[0]]=URL.createObjectURL(blob);available++;missing.shift();voiceStatus(`${available}/${JESSE_FILES.length} Jesse voice clips ready`);}catch(e){voiceStatus(`${available}/${JESSE_FILES.length} Jesse clips cached · internet audio source unavailable`);return;} 
 async function worker(){while(index<missing.length){let name=missing[index++];try{let ac=new AbortController(),timeout=setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),8000);let resp=await fetch(JESSE_BASE+name,{signal:ac.signal,cache:'force-cache'});clearTimeout(timeout);if(!resp.ok)continue;let blob=await resp.blob();if(blob.size<3000||blob.size>300000)continue;await voicePut(db,name,blob);VOICE_BASE64[name]=URL.createObjectURL(blob);done++}catch(e){}if(done%5===0||done===missing.length)voiceStatus(`${available+done}/${JESSE_FILES.length} Jesse voice clips ready`)} }
 await Promise.all([worker(),worker(),worker(),worker()]);voiceStatus(`${available+done}/${JESSE_FILES.length} Jesse clips cached for offline use`);
}
// On first interaction, browsers permit audio. Loading voices runs asynchronously and never blocks play.
let voiceAuto=false;window.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{if(!voiceAuto){voiceAuto=true;loadApprovedJesse().catch(()=>{})}},{once:true});
// Expose deterministic test entry points only; no hidden completion is shown to learner.
window.__fullGameTest={getMode:()=>mode,getPage:()=>page,getRound:()=>turn,getProgress:()=>state,open:openWorld,play:startMode,render:renderRound,finish:()=>completeMech(true,'debug'),goFinal:finale,ships:()=>shipState,validateVoice:()=>Object.keys(VOICE_BASE64).length};

window.__gameTest={home,openWorld,startMode,renderRound,judge,nextRound,getState:()=>state,getRound:()=>roundData(),targetArr,completeAll:()=>{for(let w of WORLDS)for(let m of w.modes)state.modes[m]=true;save();home()}};home();
</script></body></html>
